_comment: One row per store agent. This file is the local stand-in for the DynamoDB
table; the shape is identical, so switching from JsonStore to
DynamoDbStore does not change anything else.
Phone numbers here are in the 555-01xx range, which is reserved for
fiction and will never route to a real person. Replace them with the
numbers you claim in the Amazon Connect console.

tenants.business_hours: 9am to 7pm Eastern, seven days a week
disclaimers: Say once, if the caller asks about anything financial: I can give you the listed figures, but anything to do with an offer or financing goes to one of our licensed agents.
